_comment: Compiled-in SHA-256 integrity pins for the Chromium that POST /v1/runtime/install-chromium downloads. Keyed by the patchright/playwright Chromium REVISION (the NNNN in the `chromium-NNNN` cache dir, e.g. chromium-1148) -> platform-key -> lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the LAUNCHABLE browser executable (the exact per-OS binary chromium_exe_candidates() resolves). runtime_setup::verify_downloaded_chromium() consults this table after an install succeeds and BEFORE InstallState::Done; a mismatch OR a missing pin fails closed (InstallState::Error, refuse to proceed). Platform keys mirror the AUTO_UPDATE.md artifact keys: macos-aarch64, macos-x86_64, windows-x86_64, linux-x86_64.
